gridLabel: Board, {rows} by {cols}. Use the arrow keys to move.
confirmNew: Start a new fire? Your squares on this board will be lost.
confirmReveal: Show the answer? This fire will not count for your time or score.

cell.spark: {where}, the star. The fire starts here at minute 0.
cell.clue: {where}, number {minute}. The fire must arrive at minute {minute}.
cell.clueLate: {where}, number {minute}. With your firebreaks the fire cannot arrive on time.
cell.breakWrong: {where}, firebreak that a hint says is wrong

msg.start: Tap a square to place a firebreak. Tap again for a dot (no firebreak here), and once more to clear it.
msg.left: {count} to go. A number bigger than its distance from the star means something blocks the short way.
msg.oneLeft: 1 to go. A number bigger than its distance from the star means something blocks the short way.
msg.late: A ringed number can no longer burn on time. A firebreak is in its way.
msg.tooMany: Too many. You have exactly {count} firebreaks. Tap one to take it away.
msg.fullWrong: All {count} are placed, but the fire does not match yet. Look at the ringed numbers.
msg.hintWrong: The hint found a firebreak that cannot be right. It has a cross. Take it away.
msg.archive: This is a fire you already solved. Every square shows the minute it burned.

controls.reveal: Show the answer (this fire will not count)

keyboard: Keyboard: arrow keys move, Enter places, Backspace goes back one step. U undo, H hint, R start over, S show the answer.
keyboardDaily: Keyboard: arrow keys move, Enter places, Backspace goes back one step. U undo, H hint, R start over.

solved.title: Contained.
solved.revealedNote: You asked for the answer, so this fire does not count for your time or score.
solved.curveLabel: How many squares burned each minute
solved.personalBest: Your best time for this size.

share.what: What you share: how the fire grew, not where. No spoilers.
